# AI Coding Agent Instructions for 2D-Map

## Project Overview
A Unity 6 (v6000.3.6f1) 2D map game prototype with player movement and clickable enemies. Minimal scope: basic player control, enemy interaction, and visual assets.

## Architecture

### Key Components
- **Player.cs**: Rigidbody-based movement using Input System (legacy Input.GetAxis)
  - Uses `FixedUpdate()` for physics-based movement at 5 units/sec
  - Movement input from horizontal/vertical axes (WASD/arrows)
  - Requires `Rigidbody` component (not 2D) despite "2D-Map" naming
- **Enemy.cs**: Simple click-to-disable enemies using `OnMouseDown()`
  - No complex AI; enemies are passive until clicked
  - Uses `gameObject.SetActive(false)` for deactivation
- **Scene Structure**: Single scene (SampleScene.unity) with player prefab and Enemy prefab

### Input System
- Project uses **Unity Input System 1.18.0** (modern input handling)
- InputSystem_Actions.inputactions defined with "Player" map containing Move/Look actions
- However, Player.cs still uses legacy `Input.GetAxis()` — consider migrating to new Input System if expanding

### Asset Organization
- **Materials** (Assets/Mats/): Color 1-4 and generic Color materials for visual variation
- **Prefabs** (Assets/Prefabs/): Enemy.prefab for spawning
- **Scenes** (Assets/Scenes/): Single SampleScene.unity

## Development Workflow

### Building & Running
- Open project in **Unity Editor 6000.3.6f1**
- Play/test from Unity Editor
- Build via File > Build Settings (target: Windows Standalone 64-bit)
- C# project compiles to `Assembly-CSharp.dll` via MSBuild (netstandard2.1)

### Code Patterns
- **MonoBehaviour pattern**: All game logic inherits from MonoBehaviour
- **Physics handling**: Uses 3D Rigidbody (check if intentional; consider Rigidbody2D for true 2D)
- **Component access**: Via `GetComponent<T>()` in Start(); cache references
- **Event handling**: Unity lifecycle methods (Start, FixedUpdate, OnMouseDown)

## Important Conventions

### Naming & Structure
- Classes are PascalCase (Player, Enemy)
- Public fields for editor tweaking (speed = 5f)
- No namespace usage currently (global scope)
- .meta files are auto-generated by Unity — do not modify

### Physics & Collision
- Current setup uses 3D Rigidbody despite 2D game appearance
- Movement uses `rb.MovePosition()` for smooth physics-aware movement
- If adding 2D physics, switch to Rigidbody2D and Collider2D

### Common Pitfalls
- **Input System mismatch**: Project has InputSystem 1.18.0 but code uses legacy Input class
- **Physics vs 2D**: Verify whether physics should be 3D or 2D
- **Editor config**: Always sync changes in both .unity scenes and code; Unity auto-saves scenes
